description: A variable as the labels attribute is an error even when the collection is empty
notes: The README says the generated blocks are read as if they were written in place of the dynamic block, and an empty collection generates none, so this mistake affects no block. Whether the labels must be a tuple constructor at all is disputed too (see native/dynamic-blocks/labels-variable-is-error). hashicorp/hcl reads the labels attribute as a static list when it reads the dynamic block, after evaluating for_each but before iterating over it (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
reference_error: A static list expression is required
